name: Athena
tracking_subtitle: Athena absorbs CLI activity (git commits + active-runs ledger) into hourly per-project pulses she'll discuss with you when Dev Tools is on. Per-project flags live in Dev Tools → Lifecycle → Project Tracking.
tracking_master_on: ON — Sonnet consolidator runs every hour for enabled projects.
tracking_master_off: OFF — no ingestion, no LLM, no brain writes.
footer_hold_to_talk: Tap to open · hold to talk
orb_talk_hint: Tap to open · hold to talk · drag to move
_comment_orb_unread_one: Athena's floating orb — badge label when exactly 1 reply arrived while the chat panel was closed. Announced to screen readers and shown as the badge tooltip.
_comment_orb_unread_other: Athena's floating orb — badge label for 2+ replies that arrived while the chat panel was closed.
guide_click_hint: Click the highlighted area to continue
decision_composing: Composing the full picture in your Cockpit…
decision_compose_failed: Couldn't compose the visual explanation — the recommendation above still stands.
decision_recommend_read: This one's worth your personal read — open it when you can.
decision_recommend_approve: This looks low-risk — I'd approve it.
decision_recommend_review: I'd take a closer look before approving this one.
decision_recommend_resolve: This is blocking work — I'd resolve it now.
decision_recommend_review_open: Open the review to see the full context before deciding.
decision_skip_hint: Move past this one for now. It comes back next time you open the app.
decision_snooze_hint: Set this aside for ten minutes and see what else is waiting.
decision_recommend_reconnect: Anything using this credential is failing until you sign in again.
guide_pc_intro: Let me walk you through creating a persona — watch where I point.
guide_pc_open: This is the build studio, where every persona starts.
guide_pc_compose: This is where you begin — tap the center and describe, in plain language, what you want your persona to do.
guide_pc_autonomous: Prefer hands-off? Flip this on and I'll design, build, and test the whole persona myself.
guide_pc_outro: That's the whole flow. Want me to build one for you now?
guide_conn_intro: Want to connect a service like GitHub or Slack? Let me show you where.
guide_conn_vault: This is your Vault — every connection lives here, with its secrets encrypted on your device.
guide_conn_add: Open "Add new" and my setup wizard walks you through any connector: paste a key or sign in, and it's ready to use.
guide_conn_outro: That's it. Once a credential is here, pin it to a persona and it can use the service.
guide_trig_intro: Triggers are how your agents react on their own. Let me show you where they live.
guide_trig_hub: This is your Events hub — a trigger links a signal (a message, a schedule, a webhook) to the agent that should respond.
guide_trig_create: The Builder lays your routes out visually. Connect a source to an agent here, and it fires whenever that event arrives.
guide_trig_outro: That's the idea — wire a source to an agent and it runs itself. Want to open the Builder?
guide_tmpl_intro: Don't want to build from scratch? Templates are ready-made agents and teams. Let me show you.
guide_tmpl_gallery: This is the catalog — each card is a complete, pre-designed agent or team you can make your own.
guide_tmpl_adopt: Hit Adopt to copy a template into your workspace. A short questionnaire then tailors it to your tools and goals.
guide_tmpl_outro: That's it — adopt, answer a few questions, and you have a working agent in minutes.
guide_inc_intro: When something goes wrong, it doesn't get lost — it becomes an incident. Let me show you where.
guide_inc_inbox: When an agent or I flag a problem, it lands in this inbox, ranked by severity so the urgent ones rise to the top.
guide_inc_row: Open an incident to see what happened and resolve it — I'll often suggest the fix right there.
guide_inc_outro: That's triage: spot it here, open it, resolve it. Nothing slips through.
guide_goal_intro: Goals are the outcomes your teams pursue; KPIs are how you measure them. Let me show you both.
guide_goal_board: These are your goals — each one an outcome a team is working toward, tracked from idea to done.
guide_goal_card: Each goal is a card. Open it to track progress, check off milestones, and see which agent owns it.
guide_goal_kpi: KPIs are the metrics your goals move. Link a goal to a KPI so progress is measured, not guessed.
guide_goal_outro: That's the loop: set a goal, bind it to a KPI, and watch the number move. Want to set one up?
offer_intro: I can help you create that persona.
offer_build_hint: I'll generate, test, and fix it automatically.
offer_show: Show me how to build it
offer_show_hint: I'll walk you through the studio step by step.
walkthrough_offer_intro: Want me to show you, or just explain?
walkthrough_offer_show_hint: I'll walk your screen through it, step by step.
walkthrough_offer_tell_hint: I'll explain it here in chat.
walkthrough_offer_tell_prompt: Just explain {topic} in chat — I don't need the guided tour.
walkthrough_composing_hint: I'm mapping the steps against the live app — this takes a few seconds.
walkthrough_compose_failed: I couldn't compose that walkthrough. Ask me in chat and I'll explain it instead.
stt_desc: Choose how Athena hears you when you hold to talk.
stt_engine_browser_caption: Built-in, zero setup. Audio is sent to the system speech service.
stt_engine_whisper_caption: On-device transcription. Audio never leaves your machine.
stt_compare_open_hint: Hear both on your own mic before choosing.
stt_compare_hint: Record one sentence. Both engines listen to it at the same time, so the difference you see is your microphone and room, not two different takes. Nothing is saved.
stt_compare_browser_unsupported: This webview has no speech recognition, so the browser engine cannot run here.
stt_compare_whisper_unsupported: Microphone capture is unavailable, so the local engine cannot run here.
stt_compare_no_model: Pick and download a Whisper model first, then run the comparison.
stt_compare_adopt_hint: Whisper transcribed this take on this machine. Switch voice input to Whisper and your microphone audio stops leaving the device.
stt_browser_disclosure: On this platform, browser dictation streams your microphone audio to the OS vendor's cloud speech service. Switch to Local Whisper to keep audio on-device.
stt_engine_status_desc: Local transcription needs the whisper.cpp binary installed.
stt_models_engine_first: The engine above is not installed yet. You can download a model now, but transcription only works once both are in place.
stt_install_desc: Downloads the whisper.cpp build and puts it where Athena looks for it. About 8 MB, Windows only for now.
stt_models_desc: Download a model, then select it. Smaller = faster; larger = more accurate.
hello_phase_zero: I'm here, but I haven't found my voice yet — chat lands in the next phase.
welcome_subtitle: I can see your agents, executions, and memory. Ask me anything, or start with one of these.
slow_progress_soft: Still working — taking a bit longer than usual.
slow_progress_firm: Athena is still working. Click the stop button if you'd like to interrupt.
recall_empty: Athena spoke from a blank brain this turn.
recall_combined: Athena replayed {episodes} recent turns and consulted {memories} memories.
recall_synthesized_tooltip: Raw recall was over budget — Athena summarized it into a focused briefing before responding.
recall_dropped_far: {count} more were found and set aside for scoring below the {floor} relevance floor.
connector_call_in_flight_hint: Athena will summarize the result when this finishes.
autonomous_toggle_on: Enable autonomous mode (Athena keeps working between turns)
composer_placeholder: Talk to Athena. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.
slash_message_intake: Let's do the intake — ask me a few things so you understand how I work, then save what you learn to your identity notes (with my approval).
slash_message_queued: What jobs are queued right now?
slash_message_decisions: Read back the recent design decisions.
slash_message_live_ops: What's running in the fleet right now?
slash_message_memory_recap: What do you remember about me?
doctrine_up_to_date: Athena's docs are up to date.
analyze_fleet_started: Fleet analysis started — Athena is reviewing the teams.
daily_brief_started: Daily brief started — Athena is reviewing your last 24h.
voice_test_unconfigured: Configure a voice in the Voice tab to test.
voice_test_sentence: Hello, I am Athena, your personal AI assistant.
brain_empty_hint: This memory fills in as you and Athena work together.
brain_empty_ask_prompt: Help me build out your {kind} memory — what belongs here, and can we add the first entry now?
brain_empty_consolidation_started: Consolidation started — review the proposals in the Memory tab.
brain_desc_identity: Who Athena understands you to be — role, preferences, working style.
brain_desc_facts_user: Durable facts about you she's learned and reuses across sessions.
brain_desc_facts_project: What she knows about your active projects and their context.
brain_desc_facts_world: General facts not tied to you or a specific project.
brain_desc_goals: What you're working toward, so she can track progress.
brain_desc_backlog: Ideas and tasks parked for later.
brain_desc_procedurals: Repeatable how-to steps she's agreed to follow.
brain_desc_rituals: Recurring routines she runs on a cadence.
brain_desc_episodes: A log of past conversations she can replay.
brain_desc_reflections: Periodic self-summaries of what she's learned.
brain_desc_design_decisions: Choices made while designing personas, with rationale.
brain_desc_doctrine: Reference guides that shape how she reasons.
brain_desc_constitution: Her core operating contract — the rules she won't break.
identity_edit_hint: You're the editor of record — Athena proposes changes for your approval.
identity_correct_hint: Mark anything Athena got wrong — she'll propose removing it for your approval, and learn from the correction.
facts_subtitle: Distilled facts with source episodes — the anti-hallucination contract.
facts_empty_user: No facts about you yet. Try asking Athena to remember something specific.
setup_memory_desc: Tune how Athena recalls and shapes context for each turn.
setup_recall_synthesis_desc: On dense-recall turns, fold the brain's retrieved chunks through a Claude call into a focused briefing. Adds ~1 extra Claude call on qualifying turns; below the budget threshold no synthesis fires.
setup_hands_free_decisions_desc: Surface pending approvals, reviews, and blocking incidents as numbered choices above the orb, one at a time.
setup_desktop_desc: What Athena observes from your desktop. All sources start off. Disabling a source also clears what was already captured.
setup_desktop_clipboard_desc: Track when the clipboard changes (metadata only — content not stored).
setup_desktop_file_changes_desc: Watch declared work-roots for create / modify / delete events.
setup_desktop_app_focus_desc: Track which app is in the foreground. Window titles redacted at capture (paths reduced to filenames, emails masked).
setup_desktop_cli_session_desc: Let opted-in personas read your most recent Claude CLI conversation as prompt context. Per-persona opt-in required; only the last 8 turns are extracted, capped to 500 chars each.
sensory_cli_reads_empty_hint: When a persona with CLI awareness opted in fires while you're mid-conversation in `claude`, the read will be logged here.
setup_desktop_load_failed: Couldn't load desktop-awareness state — check the backend connection.
sensory_signals_subtitle: Recent signals captured by the desktop-awareness watchers. Delete any row to remove it from Athena's rolling window.
sensory_signals_empty_hint: Either the watchers are off (Setup → Desktop awareness) or the rolling window is empty.
chat_card_unknown_kind: Athena tried to show a card we don't recognize yet — looks like something updated. Reopen the chat to refresh.
chat_cards_restored_label: Waiting on you from an earlier turn
persona_overview_hover_hint: Hover a node to inspect it. Click to open in the editor.
persona_overview_kpi_trust_clamped: Trust score was out of range and has been capped at 100%.
persona_overview_next_step_pick_body: Tap a persona to open it in the editor.
persona_overview_next_step_tune_body: Adjust model tier, budget, or trust score.
persona_overview_next_step_run_body: Send a real input from the play surface.
walkthrough_empty: Athena's walkthrough card was empty — try asking again with more specifics.
browser_report_empty: The browser-test report card was empty.
browser_bridge_desc: Pair the Athena Browser Bridge extension so live tests run in your own Chrome. Without it, tests fall back to a bundled browser.
browser_bridge_env_override: The token is set by the PERSONAS_BROWSER_BRIDGE_TOKEN environment variable for this run — the stored token is inactive.
browser_bridge_hint: Load the extension from tools/athena-browser-extension (chrome://extensions → Load unpacked), then paste the port and token into its options page.
template_suggestions_empty: No templates in your gallery match this intent yet. Worth a build from scratch — or browse the full catalog.
use_case_set_empty: Athena's use-case proposal was empty — try asking again.
trigger_set_empty: Athena's trigger proposal was empty — try asking again.
model_tier_empty: Athena's tier comparison was empty — try asking again.
observability_plan_empty: Athena's observability plan was empty — try asking again.
decision_log_empty: Athena hasn't logged any decisions for this conversation yet.
decision_log_persisted_tooltip: Athena writes every decision_log entry into companion_design_decision so the audit trail survives session reloads.
persona_ready_empty: Athena's recap needs at least a refined intent line. Try asking again.
persona_ready_hint_interactive: Build with the standard ask-the-user gate flow.
persona_ready_hint_oneshot: Athena will decide everything and ping you when done.
persona_ready_hint_template: Open the template gallery to pick a starter.
design_cap_title: What I can help you design
design_cap_walkthrough_behavior: I sketch the full plan: intent line, prompt outline, use cases, tools, triggers, tier, observability.
design_cap_walkthrough_example: "Help me design a persona that triages support tickets."
design_cap_templates_behavior: I match your intent against the template gallery and surface the top 3 starters.
design_cap_use_cases_behavior: I propose 3-5 use cases tagged golden / variant / out-of-scope so coverage is glanceable.
design_cap_use_cases_example: "What use cases would this persona need?"
design_cap_triggers_behavior: I propose 1-4 trigger configurations with source, condition, grain, idempotency notes.
design_cap_tier_behavior: I compare Haiku / Sonnet / Opus for this intent and recommend one with rationale.
design_cap_observability_behavior: I draft the error-handling and success-metric pair so this persona never black-holes.
design_cap_decision_log_behavior: I track design choices during the conversation as a timeline so you can retrace later.
design_cap_decision_log_example: "Show me what we've decided so far."
design_cap_ready_behavior: I roll everything into one build-ready card with a commit button when the design is locked in.
memory_rebuild_search_unavailable: This build has no embedding model, so semantic search cannot be rebuilt.
memory_bulk_actions_desc: Manual maintenance passes that distill conversations into long-lived facts and surface patterns.
consolidation_running_long: Athena is reviewing your recent conversations and proposing fact updates. This usually takes 1-3 minutes.
consolidation_review_subtitle: Each row is a proposed fact. Approve, reject, or edit before it lands in memory.
consolidation_no_proposals: Athena had nothing new to consolidate from this batch.
decay_none: No facts old enough to decay yet.
page_subtitle: Setup, memory inspector, and voice configuration for your thinking partner.
decisions_panel_subtitle: Every design choice Athena has logged across conversations. Filter by persona context to scope.
decisions_panel_empty: Athena hasn't logged any design decisions yet. Ask her to design a persona to see this fill up.
decisions_panel_empty_cta: Ask Athena to log a decision
decisions_panel_empty_prompt: I'd like to log a design decision. Ask me what I chose, the alternatives I weighed, and my reasoning — then record it for me.
decisions_panel_empty_filtered: No decisions match that context. Try a shorter filter or clear it.
dashboard_empty_body: Ask Athena to compose one for you — for example, "Show me my agent activity for the past week."
setup_chrome_desc: Where Athena shows up in the app and how she gets your attention.
setup_footer_desc: Display the bot button in the bottom-left footer. When off, the chat panel is unreachable except via this plugin page.
setup_orb_desc: Show Athena as a draggable orb that floats above the app. Tap to open chat, hold to talk, drag to dock anywhere. When off, only the footer button remains.
setup_sound_desc: Play a short two-note tone when Athena finishes a reply, even if you've tabbed away.
setup_beta_desc: Experimental capabilities. Dev mode is toggled from the wrench in the chat header; other flags are read-only here.
voice_subtitle: Have Athena speak her replies via ElevenLabs. Configuration only — playback in chat is downstream.
voice_empty_desc: Voice playback runs through your own ElevenLabs API key. Add a credential in the vault to continue.
voice_credential_desc: Which ElevenLabs key Athena uses for synthesis.
voice_id_desc: The ElevenLabs voice id Athena should use. Find it on the ElevenLabs voice library page.
voice_id_hint: 21–32 characters, alphanumeric. Each voice has a unique id you can copy from the ElevenLabs library.
voice_enable_desc: Master switch for voice playback. Requires a credential and a voice id.
voice_enable_on: Athena will speak her replies aloud. Playback wiring lands in a follow-up.
voice_enable_blocked: Pick a credential and enter a voice id first.
voice_pick_desc: Pick from voices scoped to this credential, or list every voice on the account.
voice_pick_no_voices: No voices found on this account.
voice_pick_scoped_hint: Showing voices scoped to this credential. Edit scope from the credential detail to change.
voice_pick_unscoped_hint: No scope set — listing every voice on this account. Add a scope in the credential detail to narrow this down.
voice_settings_desc: Tune model, expressiveness, and pace. Leave on default unless Athena's voice feels off.
voice_settings_model_hint: Turbo is the fastest and cheapest. Multilingual and v3 are the most expressive but slower.
voice_settings_stability_hint: Lower = more emotion and variation. Higher = more consistent and monotone.
voice_settings_similarity_hint: How closely Athena should match the picked voice's reference recordings.
voice_settings_speed_hint: Speech rate. Range 0.7–1.2; default speed sits in the middle. Leave at default to omit.
voice_settings_style_hint: Only meaningful on Multilingual v2 and v3. Higher values amplify expressive cues at the cost of consistency.
voice_engine_desc: Both engines run locally on your machine — no network, no API key — after a one-time install. Kokoro is the polished default; Pocket is experimental and can speak with a voice cloned from your own recording.
voice_kokoro_setup_desc: Kokoro synthesizes locally through the sherpa-onnx sidecar. Two one-time installs: the engine binary and the voice model package.
voice_kokoro_engine_hint: Download the win-x64-shared-MT-Release build of sherpa-onnx and unzip sherpa-onnx-offline-tts.exe (with its onnxruntime DLLs) into the folder below.
voice_kokoro_model_hint: Download kokoro-multi-lang-v1_0.tar.bz2, extract it, and put model.onnx + voices.bin + tokens.txt + the espeak-ng-data folder into the folder below.
voice_kokoro_install_desc: Download and set up Kokoro automatically — about 400 MB (the af_heart English voice).
voice_kokoro_voices_desc: All voices ship in one model — pick one and press Preview to hear it. af_heart is Kokoro's warm, expressive default.
voice_kokoro_enable_blocked: Install the engine + model and pick a voice first
voice_piper_engine_status_desc: Athena synthesizes with the official Piper binary. Install once; voices download separately below.
voice_piper_engine_install_hint_release: Releases at github.com/rhasspy/piper/releases (the Windows zip contains piper.exe + onnxruntime.dll)
voice_piper_voices_desc: Pick a voice and click Download. Models live under ~/.personas/companion-tts/piper/ and are ~7–110 MB depending on quality.
voice_piper_no_voice_selected: Pick a voice from the list below to enable Piper synthesis.
voice_piper_engine_missing_callout: Install the Piper engine first to use the selected voice.
voice_piper_no_voices_for_language: No Piper voice covers your locale yet. Try a different language or fall back to ElevenLabs.
dictate_start_hint: Press to talk. Audio is sent to the browser's cloud speech-to-text service while listening.
dictate_error: Dictation failed. Check microphone permission and try again.

orchestration.guidance_placeholder: Type your answer — claude is paused on this RPC.

wake_cadence_hint: How long signals accumulate before Athena wakes and handles them in one batch. Blocked teams and urgent messages bypass the timer.
boldness_hint: How far Athena acts on her own on a paused CLI before asking you. Cautious = only the obviously-right call; Balanced = she proceeds on reversible next steps and asks on real choices; Bold = she proceeds on both unless she's genuinely unsure. Low confidence always asks.
dev_toggle_on: Enable dev mode (Athena can work on the Personas app’s own code)
dev_ledger_hint: Every dev_improve run Athena dispatched, with your verdict. The scoreboard tells you whether dev mode is earning its keep — how many dispatches land a commit, how many merge, and your thumbs ratio.
dev_ledger_empty: No dev runs yet — Athena logs each dispatch here.
attention_blocked_hint: Something is parked until you answer: a spawned session's request, or a decision Athena is holding.
attention_errors_hint: Runs that failed, sessions stuck mid-dispatch, blocking incidents, and aging backlog items.
attention_warnings_hint: Things drifting off track: sessions awaiting input or going stale, goals nearing their target, runs worth reviewing.
attention_nudges_hint: Informational nudges: digests, scheduled check-ins, completed operations, things she noticed.
attention_assignments_hint: Team assignments Athena dispatched. Click a card to open the full pipeline view.
attention_activity_hint: What Athena did on her own without asking, kept as a session record.
dev_dump_log_failed: Failed to save the conversation log
sleep_cycle_force: Force a memory sleep cycle now
sleep_cycle_started: Sleep cycle {id} started. Watch it in Memory.
sleep_cycle_failed: Could not start the sleep cycle
daily_goals_streak_hint: Consecutive days with all daily goals accomplished. Finishing today's set keeps the streak alive; a missed day resets it.
daily_goals_modal_hint: Up to 3 goals for today. You judge completion yourself; when every goal is done, the set clears and the streak grows.
daily_goals_goal_placeholder: What do you want to accomplish?
daily_goals_edit_hint: The full text of each goal, editable. Fill an empty slot to add a goal (3 max). To drop one, mark it done or discard the whole set.
setup_dev_mode_on: Available in this build. The wrench in the chat header toggles it — when on, Athena resolves feature talk to code and proposes improvement dispatches you approve.
setup_dev_mode_off: Unavailable — requires a development build running from a source checkout.
voice_pocket_setup_desc: Pocket synthesizes through a small local service that keeps the model warm. It can speak with a cloned voice built from a short recording of you.
voice_pocket_not_running_hint: Start the Pocket TTS service on this computer, then re-check. Voices appear once the service is reachable at the address below.
voice_pocket_voices_desc: Cloned voices come from the service's voices folder — drop in a new voice file and re-check. The rest are built-in voices.
voice_pocket_enable_blocked: Install the Pocket engine (or start the service) and select a voice to enable playback.
voice_pocket_packaged_desc: Pocket speaks with a voice cloned from a short recording. Everything runs on this computer — one engine, one voice model, no account.
voice_pocket_engine_hint: Get the sherpa-onnx release for your platform and drop the binary and its DLLs into the folder below.
voice_pocket_model_hint: Download the Pocket voice model package and extract its files into the folder below.
voice_pocket_install_desc: Downloads the speech engine (~23 MB) and the voice model (~98 MB), then sets everything up automatically.
voice_pocket_voices_dir_hint: Add a voice by dropping a 10–30 second .wav recording into this folder, then re-check. The file name becomes the voice name.
voice_pocket_service_desc: Optional. A running Pocket TTS service adds the built-in voice catalog and faster repeated playback.
voice_pocket_upload_hint: Upload a 10–30 second recording of one person speaking clearly — most audio formats work. The recording's quality carries over, so use a clean take.
voice_pocket_upload_decode_failed: Couldn't read that audio file — try a different format or re-export it.
voice_pocket_hf_gate_desc: Managing your own cloned voices requires a Hugging Face access token in the Credential Vault — it anchors the voice-cloning model license to your account. Add a Hugging Face credential, then come back here.
voice_pocket_delete_body: The reference recording for this voice will be deleted from this computer.
action_label_apply_pattern: Apply adopted patterns in a repo
action_label_evaluate_pattern: Verify pattern adherence in a repo
decision_run_failed: That did not go through. Pick an option again to retry.
fleet_plan_empty: No sessions left in this plan. Cancel it, or ask Athena for a new one.
fleet_plan_containment_note: Sessions start only inside registered dev projects.
ship_milestone_empty: Nothing left in this milestone. Cancel it, or ask Athena for a new one.
ship_milestone_description_placeholder: Optional note on why this item made the cut
ship_milestone_planned_note: The milestone is created as planned. Cutting and shipping stay yours.
dev_self_review_failed: Could not start the dev self-review
dev_self_review_hint: Athena reads her own dispatch record, writes down what makes her dev runs land, and may propose one improvement.
dev_self_review_started: Reviewing {count} dev runs. Athena will reply in the chat.
canvas_note_camera_focus: Travelled to a project on the canvas
canvas_note_dim_open: Opened a dimension on the canvas
canvas_note_category_open: Opened a category on the canvas
canvas_note_island_menu: Opened a project menu on the canvas
canvas_note_reason_unknown_slug: that project isn't on the canvas
canvas_note_reason_band_too_far: the view was zoomed too far out
canvas_note_reason_demo_scene: the canvas is showing demo data
global_hotkey_desc: Reach Athena by voice while another app has focus, not just when the Personas window is in front.
global_hotkey_in_app_only: Works only while Personas is in front
global_hotkey_failed: Another app is already using that shortcut, so it could not be enabled.
ship_milestone_prose_placeholder: Optional: what shipping this milestone actually means
ship_goals_empty: Nothing left to create. Cancel this, or ask Athena to read the brief again.
ship_goals_context_label: Context this goal is filed under
ship_goals_title_placeholder: A handful of words, for example Compose the story
ship_goals_description_placeholder: Optional: what this goal actually covers
ship_goals_core_note: Every goal is added to the core cut. Moving one to later or never stays yours.
cycles_empty: No sleep cycle has run yet
cycles_empty_hint: A cycle fires once enough new conversation has accumulated. Until then there is nothing to compress.
cycles_load_failed: The sleep-cycle journal could not be read
health_load_failed: The health report could not be read
note_suggestions_question_hint: Answer this in the note, or in the chat.
note_suggestions_open_pad: Open the notepad to see where these land.
reset_confirm_body: The whole transcript is deleted. This cannot be undone.
create_line_intro: Hi, I'm Athena. I live in this app to think alongside you. Give me a few minutes and I'll show you how I appear, find my voice, and learn to hear yours. Ready?
create_line_intro_resume: Welcome back. We were partway through — shall we pick up where we left off?
create_line_intro_done: We've done this before, but I'm happy to go again. Anything you change here sticks.
create_line_footer_icon: This is my footer icon. It's the calm way to reach me: one tap opens our chat, and it glows when I have something for you.
create_line_orb: And this is my orb — a small presence that stays on screen while you work. I use it to nudge, to ask, and to listen when you hold to talk.
create_line_orb_place: Drag me wherever feels right. I'll remember the spot.
create_line_chime: When I finish a reply while you're looking elsewhere, I play a short chime so you don't have to watch the panel. Here's how it sounds.
create_line_voice_engine: Now, my voice. I speak through a local engine — everything stays on your machine. Kokoro is light with curated voices; Pocket can learn a voice from a clip.
create_line_voice_install: I'll need the engine and its model on disk. This takes a minute; you can skip and come back any time.
create_line_voice_install_manual: I can't install this one automatically here. The links below will get it in place, and I'll be waiting.
create_line_voice_install_done: All set. Let's find out what I sound like.
create_line_voice_pick: Pick a voice and press play. The first one you choose is the first thing I'll ever say out loud.
create_line_voice_pick_woke: There I am. Try a few more — each one says the same line so you can compare.
create_line_stt: Now let me hear you. Hold the button, say anything, and I'll transcribe it two ways so you can pick the one that hears you best.
create_line_handoff: That's the setup. Open our chat and I'll show you what I can actually do around here.
